desc:
👍 HUGE REWARDS AT 1,500 LIKES!

⚠️ This is a separate game inspired by STD, so your units and progress from the original game will not transfer over.

This is a Skibidi Toilet Tower Defense game in which you use Camera Men, Speaker Men and other Units to fend off the Skibidi Toilets! Don't let them reach your base, or it's GAME OVER! 

🤝 PLAY WITH FRIENDS FOR A COIN BOOST! 
⚔️ COMPETE WITH OTHERS (1v1, 2v2 OR RANKED)
👑 Premium Players get +50% Luck and +1 Coins in the AFK Area! 
♾️ Up for a challenge? Try the ENDLESS Mode and see how long you can survive!

Game is similar to the Original STD Made By SuperSkibidi Games!
